## 席位核对
ACCEPT — one card, one PR, not governed (`check-governed-merges.mjs`: NOT governed), +140/-0 over three files, Clause-② no, Metadata-protocol none.

1. **Shape.** `Fixes #36404`; no other card bound; files: `recordDetailSections.ts` (+14, of which 11 comment lines), the new pin `recordDetailSections.moreDetailsEmptyReveal-36404.test.tsx`, one changeset.
2. **Premise measured.** Reproduced on main `ad50d611` through the real default-page path (`deriveRecordDetailSections` → `buildDefaultPageSchema` → `record:details` inside `RecordPageColumns`): an empty textarea alone in the synthesized "More details" section was left out of the "Show N empty fields" count (`expected '1' to be '2'`) and never drawn.
3. **Code read.** Root cause at the producer: `record:details` resolves an omitted `hideEmpty` to `true`, and nobody authors the synthesized sections, so nobody could write `false`. `splitPrimarySecondary` now writes `hideEmpty: false` on all three sections it makes (untitled primary, "More details", the ungrouped remainder), the value the section contract already declares for keeping a section. Authored pages are untouched; the #36147 ruling 7066516044 item 4 row is unchanged. Ablation: the file restored to `ad50d611` turns the pin red (1 failed of 2), restored again green.
4. **Gates.** 39 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending at this head (Test UI shards included); Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check green; dev's 38 derived gates with 0 NOT MEASURED, the plugin-detail + app-shell `RecordDetailView*` run (512 files) under the lock.
5. **Accepted deviations.** (a) Declared narrowing: the verify lock was held by the #36488 run, so the pin, its reproduction and 14 targeted files ran outside it with one worker; CI's Test UI shards at this head are the full reading. (b) A record page Studio seeds from these derived sections now saves `hideEmpty: false` on them; it is the contract's own value and the changeset says so.
6. **Out of scope.** An all-empty declared field group on the default page has the same symptom; filed by the seat as #36593, not widened here.

Landing: area lands it (non-governed, under 3000 lines): ready + auto-merge.
